params.minAmountOut: Minimum tokens the swap must return (slippage protection against MEV).                     The caller (liquidation bot) should derive this from an oracle quote.
params.trader: The trader whose position will be liquidated.

positionCurrencies((address,address,uint.details: Needed by off-chain/keeper consumers because `isLong` is anchored to the      pool's configured base currency (see setBaseCurrency) and therefore no      longer maps 1:1 to currency0.

setBaseCurrency(bytes32,address).details: Determines the meaning of the reported `isLong` flag: a position whose      collateral is the base token is LONG, otherwise SHORT. Defaults to      currency0 when unset. On Unichain (currency0=USDC, currency1=WETH) set      this to WETH so "long WETH" positions report isLong=true.

setTokenDecimals(address,uint8).details: Required for pools containing non-18-decimal tokens (e.g. 6-decimal USDC)      so the V4-spot vs V3-TWAP circuit breaker compares like-for-like prices.      Unconfigured tokens are assumed to be 18 decimals.

closePosition((address,address,uint24,in.notice: Closes a leveraged margin position, settling solver debt and returning profit.

deployCollateral((address,address,uint24.notice: STEP 3: Smart Collateral Rehypothecation (0% Interest) Deploy the entire collateral as concentrated liquidity to harvest fees. Called by the Router AFTER the swap to avoid re-entrancy locks.

executeLiquidation((address,address,uint.notice: Executes a forced liquidation of an underwater position.

getHookTVL(address).notice: Returns the total value locked within the hook for a specific currency.

getSwappableCapacity(address).notice: Returns the immediately swappable liquidity (capacity) of the hook.

getTotalCollateralUSD().notice: Returns a real protocol-wide collateral aggregate in token units. For USD value, multiply externally by the oracle price. This is intentionally gas-cheap: it sums running totals, not on-chain iteration.

getTotalDebtUSD().notice: Returns a real protocol-wide borrow aggregate in token units. Tracks cumulatively via totalBorrowedByToken; call priceFeed externally for USD.

positionCurrencies((address,address,uint.notice: Resolves the collateral and debt currencies for a trader's position.

registerSolverDebt(bytes32,address,addre.notice: Registers solver debt when a leveraged margin position is opened.

seedInsuranceFund(address,uint256).notice: Seed the insurance fund using physical ERC20s, converting them to 6909s.

setBaseCurrency(bytes32,address).notice: Configures the base (underlying) token for a pool.

setReserveFactor(uint256).notice: Allows the owner to dynamically lower or adjust the reserve fee to compete with aggregators. Maximum safety ceiling is set to 100 basis points (1.0%) to protect traders.

setTokenDecimals(address,uint8).notice: Configures the ERC-20 decimals for a pool token.

withdrawAllProtocolFees(address).notice: Withdraws all protocol fees for a given currency to the treasury.

withdrawInsuranceFund(address,address,ui.notice: Withdraws physically settled tokens from the Insurance Fund.

withdrawProtocolFee(address,uint256).notice: Withdraws accumulated protocol fees to the treasury address.
